sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा वानरैः सविभीषणैः ।अब्रवीद्राघवः श्रीमान् ससुग्रीवविभीषणान् ।। ६.१२५.२३ ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā vānaraiḥ savibhīṣaṇaiḥ ।abravīdrāghavaḥ śrīmān sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇān ।। 6.125.23 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva and the Vanaras, quickly ascended the aerial car. Vibheeshana, the king of Rakshasas and ministers all of them ascended.
